richiami.difetto: Welds may fail on steering wheel initially causing some free play which if allowed to progress could lead to loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected to replace the steering wheel with one of a modified design.

richiami.difetto: There is a possibility of welds cracking on the steering wheel.  In extreme circumstances if the symptoms are ignored the cracks can progress into total separation causing loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the vehicles that are likely to be affected and replace the steering wheel with a redesigned steering wheel.

richiami.difetto: The front suspension lower swivel joint ball pin may break and cause a loss of steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Fit modified swivel joints to the right and left side front suspension units.
richiami.titolo: FAILURE OF SWIVEL JOINT BALL PIN

richiami.difetto: Under rigorous driving conditions there is a possibility that the tie-rod may fracture and may affect steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall affected vehicles and replace tie-rod with modified type.

richiami.difetto: The steering idler arm may not have adequate end clearance on its fulcrum and could pick up on its retaining nut shearing the split pin. This could allow detachment of the nut with an adverse effect on steering control.
richiami.rimedio: Recall the affected vehicles and check that the steering idler arm has adequate end clearance on its fulcrum. Where the clearance is insufficient the correct clearance will be established by shimming.
